lines: - `[FONT_REMOTE] "JetBrains Mono"`: the font loads from Google Fonts at runtime.

- `.design-sync/stores.ts` re-exports every zustand store hook through the bundle. Previews import them from `'@cipherbox/web'` (for example `useAuthStore`) and seed state with `useAuthStore.setState({...})` at module top. A relative import of the store file would create a second store instance that the components do not read.

+- Capture loads one story per page (`?story=<Cell>`). A cell can seed a store inside its own body (`useMemo(() => useXStore.setState({...}), [])`) and sweep store state across cells without leaks. SyncIndicator does this.

+- Overlay components (Modal, Portal, dialogs, ContextMenu, NotificationToast) land inside their card because of the per-page capture. Only SearchPalette needed `cardMode: single`; its fixed backdrop painted a band above the card.

+- The dialogs agent proposed `cardMode: single` with short viewports for every dialog for density only. Not applied: single mode hides the variant cells in the pane. Revisit if the pane looks sparse.
+- `SharedListRow` and `SharedFolderRow` need an ancestor with class `shared-browser`; the grid rules are scoped under it. `FileListItem` rows need the `file-list` ancestor the same way.
+- `SharedFolderRow` takes `isSelected`, but no stylesheet defines `.file-list-row--selected`. App gap, not a preview defect.
+- `FileBrowser` reads the root from `useFolderStore.folders.root`. Seed a node with `folderKey: null` and `sequenceNumber: BigInt(n)`.
+- `StorageTab` must not see a seeded `vaultKeypair`: it derives an IPNS keypair and resolves a record, and the card stays on loading. Seed `teeKeys` only.
+- Open-prop names differ: 12 dialogs take `open`, `ShareDialog` takes `isOpen`, `ReplaceFileDialog` opens from a non-empty `replacements` array.
+- Emitted `.d.ts` files mark `item` and `folderKey` as non-nullable, but the sources accept `null`.
+- Media dialogs (audio, image, pdf, video) render two real error states: no folder key, and no keypair.

+- MatrixBackground is `position: fixed; z-index: -1`; its preview wraps it in a positioned stacking context. NotificationToast is fixed bottom-right; its preview wraps it in `transform: translateZ(0)`.
+- Cells lay out in alphabetical order of the export name with a fixed slot height. Tall content clips. FileDetails uses one version entry for that reason.
+- Parallel captures can hit `page.goto: Timeout 20000ms`. Re-run only the failed components.

+- StagingBanner: gated on `import.meta.env.VITE_ENVIRONMENT === 'staging'`. The converter defines `import.meta.env` as a fixed object without VITE_ keys (`.ds-sync/lib/common.mjs`, `IIFE_IMPORT_META_DEFINE`). Same cause: GoogleLoginButton shows only `[GOOGLE - NOT CONFIGURED]`, and the AppShell staging branch is unreachable.
+- DeviceApprovalModal: renders only with a pending request from the bulletin-board polling API. No prop or store seam.
+- MigrationProgress: renders only with a live migration status from the API. `setApiClientConfig` is never called in the frame.
+- AuthorizedDevices and RecoveryPhraseSection are graded good in their loading and no-phrase states. Their factor lists need a LOGGED_IN CoreKit.
+- `apps/web/types/` is generated and gitignored. Run `node .design-sync/emit-types.mjs` before the converter, or every `.d.ts` comes back empty.
+- The store re-export list in `.design-sync/stores.ts` was generated from `apps/web/src/stores/*.store.ts`. A new store is not exported until the file is regenerated.
+- `DsFrame.tsx` mirrors the provider tree in `apps/web/src/main.tsx`. A new provider there must be added to the frame.

+- Preview fixtures inline `FolderChild`, `FolderNode`, `FileMetadata`, and `VersionEntry` shapes. A schema change in `@cipherbox/core` breaks them at preview compile time; the build log prints `! preview build failed: <Name>`.
+- The font comes from Google Fonts at runtime. Offline captures render in the fallback monospace font.

## 2026-09-13 — /design-sync of an app monorepo (cipher-box-v1, apps/web)

- Problem: the web app ships no dist and no declarations, so every `<Name>Props` came back empty.
  Lesson: emit a declaration tree with a dedicated tsconfig (`emitDeclarationOnly`) into `<pkg>/types/` plus an `index.d.ts` barrel; the converter reads `types/` as a fallback root. Pin inline-parameter props with `dtsPropsFor`.
- Problem: dark-only app rendered green on white in cards, and components threw for router, query client, CoreKit, wagmi.
  Lesson: write a `DsFrame` provider (extra entry + `cfg.provider`) that mirrors `main.tsx`; import the app polyfills first; build a wagmi config with `connectors: []` because `wagmi/connectors` pulls unresolvable optional SDKs.
- Problem: a provider frame with inline padding kept null renders at 32px, so the floor card never fired.
  Lesson: put frame padding in CSS under `.ds-frame:not(:empty)` and collapse `#root:has(> .ds-frame:empty)`.
- Problem: zustand stores are global in the grid page, so store-driven variants collapse and trip `variants render identically`.
  Lesson: export store hooks through the bundle, seed per cell, and use `cardMode: single` with a `primaryStory` for the card, or accept one cell.
- Problem: `validate | tail -12` hid 70 `[GRID_OVERFLOW]` warns.
  Lesson: read `.render-check.json` `suggestedOverride` and apply it in bulk, then one targeted `preview-rebuild.mjs`.
- Tooling: 6 parallel Opus sub-agents over disjoint component sets authored 68 previews in about 6 minutes each; parallel captures can hit `page.goto` timeouts, re-run only those components.
EOF
echo ok
